body: Index page polls /api/v1/promptoverse/nodes every 10s and re-renders (same idiom as OKEMILY/tournaments.html hero leaderboard). New Style pages at /prompt-o-verse/style/<label-slug>/, linked from every leaf's h1 and index headings, mirrors Subject pages for the other taxonomy axis, no leaf-count threshold. Rerender tool used to backfill all existing nodes. Commit 59b6f0f.
title: Prompt-o-verse gallery live-updates + Style/<label> pages
